'''Docking bay 49''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Morado]]. [[Kinnin Vo-Shay]] berthed his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], ''[[Ashanda Ray]]'', in docking bay 49 during his visit to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TLH">{{JournalCite|13|The Last Hand (short story)}}</ref>
